Welcome to Kanes Hill Primary School where we 'Believe Achieve Succeed'!
At Kanes Hill Primary School, it is our belief that every child has limitless potential, and we are passionate about unlocking this to develop their confidence, uncover their talents and nurture their aspirations, empowering them to build strong foundations for lifelong learning.
We have high expectations and encourage our pupils to believe in themselves, to take risks, and to be resilient and hardworking in order to achieve and succeed both academically and personally.

Music Skills Progression
Year 1 & 2
Understand that different instruments are used to provide different sounds and for different effects.

Joins in with group singing, building a repertoire of songs.
Use chants and rhymes to build rhythmic capability.

Perform using graphic scores and other simple notation.
Improvising & Composing
Explore sounds on tuned and untuned instruments.

Listen to their own compositions and that of others and suggest improvements.

Develop confidence, resilience and individuality.

Confidently sing a variety of songs from different genres with accuracy of pitch.

pageCache.pageTitle: Kanes Hill Primary School - Instrumental learning
pageCache.text:
Instrumental learning
At Kanes Hill we work very closely with Southampton Music Hub to offer our instrumental learning. We are proud that all our provision is provided for free to our children and Southampton Music Hub loan instruments to all our children at no cost to parents.
As part of our curriculum learning children in Year 2 learn to play the Recorder and children in Year 3 learn to play the Ukulele. This ensures our children are ready for our First Access provision in Year 4.
Pupils in Year 4 take part in 'In2music' where they are offered the opportunity to learn either the Violin, Clarinet or Trumpet for the year. We have three amazing teachers who visit the school every Wednesday morning to teach our children; Mrs Porter, our string teacher, Mr Hanchett, our brass teacher, and Mr Farrendon, our woodwind teacher. During the year the children go to Central Hall to see the Children's Concert before performing their own concert for parents and take part in a city celebration ensemble in the Summer Term.
Children in Year 5 and Year 6 choose whether they would like to continue learning their instrument in small group lessons. We are proud of the high numbers of pupils who choose to continue their learning.
During the year all Year 5 and Year 6 pupils join together to play as part of our Kanes Hill Orchestra.
